purpose: Teach: 吸収/原料/発掘/天候/未知/絶滅/換算/沿岸

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、技術、絶対、吸収、絶対、海外から、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need us to pursue overseas technology acquisition with absolute seriousness. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding opening. Sharp attack on each directive. Measured authority without volume. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed. Slight pause between ideas for weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、原料、絶対、調達先、絶対、見直しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're currently reviewing our raw material supply chains with full commitment and urgency.
lines.style: Steady, formal report-back. Measured pace, precise diction. Respectful but not deferential — the tone of someone competent delivering progress to leadership. Even breathing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新規市場の、本気で、絶対、発掘、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: New market exploration. Push that forward. I'm counting on it.
lines.style: Direct and economical. Slightly softer than the first line but no less firm. The brevity carries weight. Slight exhale after 'forward' — confidence in being understood.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、天候、絶対、不順、絶対、影響、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively monitoring weather pattern impacts on our operations and supply.
lines.style: Professional delivery of concrete information. No hesitation. Slightly quicker pace than before — demonstrating capability and thoroughness. Composed, assured tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 未知、本気で、絶対、の市場、絶対、調査しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Investigate untapped markets. Do it thoroughly. Make it happen.
lines.style: Staccato phrasing, minimal words. Each sentence a small directive. Quiet intensity. The confidence of someone who doesn't need to raise volume to command attention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、伝統技術、絶対、絶滅、絶対、防ぐ、絶対、取り組み、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively working to preserve traditional craft techniques through targeted initiatives and partnerships.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful delivery. Slightly slower pace — this is a sensitive area. Sincere without being emotional. Demonstrates that the team understands both the business and cultural weight of this directive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 外貨、本気で、絶対、換算、絶対、レート、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Verify foreign exchange rates. Current positions. Keep me informed.
lines.style: Sharp, economical. Three separate thoughts, each with its own beat. No rush but no drift. The tone of someone who expects precision and won't accept excuses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、沿岸、絶対、地域への、絶対、出店、絶対、検討しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're evaluating coastal market expansion opportunities and preparing to move forward on promising locations.
lines.style: Clear, confident conclusion to the exchange. Slightly warmer than previous updates — this is forward momentum. Measured pace, full breath. Demonstrates readiness and completion of briefing.
